question: Which club set a record for the most consecutive victories in men’s soccer (34 in a row) by April 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Al Hilal**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Saudi Arabian** club **Al Hilal** established a new world record for the **most consecutive victories** in men’s professional top-flight soccer, reaching an unprecedented **34 consecutive wins**.
 
• This historic winning streak began in **September 2023** and concluded in **April 2024**. The record was officially acknowledged by **Guinness World Records**.
 
• The streak spanned multiple high-level competitions, including the **Saudi Pro League**, the **King’s Cup**, and the **AFC Champions League**.
